foods
• See Table 15.13. Identify and avoid problem

• Assess potential for lactose intolerance.
• Soak dried beans in water overnight; then discard
water and cook soaked beans in new water.
Eating tips
• Cut back on fried and higher-fat foods.
• Eat smaller meals throughout the day.
• Avoid eating while anxious, upset, or on the run.
• Avoid carbonated beverages.
Personal habits
• Increase physical activity for a minimum of thirty
minutes daily.
Medications
• Nonprescription antigas products (e.g., Beano™)
help break down sugars found in vegetables and
grains.
• Lactase enzyme supplements (such as Dairy 
Ease™ and Lact-Aid™) can be taken with dairy
products to help break down lactose in foods.
• Peppermint tea contains menthol which may 
ease cramping and abdominal pain. (Caution:
peppermint tea may contribute to heartburn or 
acid reﬂ ux.)
